company.name: Aleph
company.shortDescription: Aleph is a financial software company that provides AI-native financial planning and analysis tools and data management infrastructure.
company.description: Aleph is a financial software company that provides AI-native financial planning and analysis tools and data management infrastructure. The company's platform helps finance teams consolidate data from multiple systems—ERP, HRIS, CRM, etc.—using over 150 no-code connectors, enabling real-time syncing and automated transformations so that data becomes clean, reliable, and ready-to-use. Its key offerings include automated financial reporting & closing, collaborative budgeting and forecasting, modeling, investor/board reporting, and headcount planning—all intended to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and scale output without scaling headcount. Aleph supports existing workflows by integrating with Excel and Google Sheets via add-ins so teams can keep using their familiar reporting tools while benefiting from automation, variance analysis, and live data dashboards.
